verdict.rationale: An API-driven payroll preview with anomaly surfacing is a fair question for a payroll/PEO product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes manual, UI-based checks of payroll data, such as the Analytics > Custom Payroll Report and employee profiles. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt returned 404, so there is no evidence of an API that can preview a payroll run or flag anomalies before approval.
